value.rationale: Sharp exact numerical upper envelope and unique high-damping D-optimal sampling design quantify the phase-separation versus exponential decay tradeoff in two-component initial-state reconstruction. The 0.63129/a timing scale and its -0.238809 correction, and the gain over the two-sample comparator, provide a motivated practical reference for experiment scheduling. Limits to one scalar output and equal time spacing are explicit.
